scope: all16 metadata only; R2 deferred features unchanged

before.name: Know what the news says about your brand
before.description: Filter a brand-search feed into linked mentions and an overall tone report, ready for your webhook.

after.name: Find your brand in a news feed
after.description: Filter a supplied brand-search feed into linked mentions and an overall tone summary, then send the report to your webhook.

before.name: Check your spending cap before real work
before.description: A budget-stop example: a zero-dollar cap should halt the run before a paid model call or outgoing message.

after.name: Test a budget stop before paid calls
after.description: Try a zero-dollar cap: the run should stop before a paid model call or outgoing message, with the reason recorded locally.

before.name: Turn your sources into a post you approve
before.description: Draft a Telegram post from source material, check its rules, and review the exact text before publishing.

after.name: Turn source material into a Telegram post you approve
after.description: Draft one Telegram post with links for its claims. Check the writing rules, review the exact text, and approve it before publishing.

before.name: Get the useful news from your feed
before.description: Turn an RSS feed into a short digest of worthwhile items and send it to Telegram.

after.name: Send the useful items from your RSS feed to Telegram
after.description: Get a short digest of worthwhile feed items with links and a skipped-item count, delivered as one Telegram message.

before.name: See why each feed item matters
before.description: Summarize up to five feed items individually and send each as a separate webhook message.

after.name: Get a separate summary for each feed item
after.description: Summarize up to the first five feed items individually and send each title, link and one-sentence summary to your webhook.

before.name: Give your tools a structured feed summary
before.description: Create a JSON feed summary, reject invalid JSON, and send its item count to your webhook.

after.name: Turn RSS headlines into structured JSON
after.description: Produce a JSON count and title list from your feed. Reject invalid JSON and send the count, run ID and cost to your webhook.

before.name: Review a currency-rate alert before sending
before.description: Have a model check USD/UAH against a threshold, then approve the alert before it reaches your webhook.

after.name: Review a currency-rate alert before it is sent
after.description: Check USD/UAH against a threshold, review the proposed alert, and approve it before it reaches your webhook.

before.name: Spot important changes in GitHub releases
before.description: Summarize a repository's releases and flag reported breaking changes, deprecations and security fixes.

after.name: See the important changes in repository releases
after.description: Read a repository’s release notes in one brief, with reported breaking changes, deprecations and security fixes called out.

before.name: Stop a rate alert that fails your rule
before.description: A model-review example: continue when the currency rate passes its rubric, or stop the run on failure.

after.name: Stop a rate alert when its rule fails
after.description: Use a model-review gate to allow a rate alert only when the supplied value passes its rubric; a failed check stops the run.

before.name: Move JSON between your tools
before.description: Read a JSON endpoint and forward its payload to a webhook, with no AI model call.

after.name: Forward endpoint data to your webhook without AI
after.description: Read a JSON endpoint and send its data inside a webhook payload with the run ID. No model call is required.

before.name: Check how your workflow handles too many items
before.description: A fan-out example: read up to 60 feed items, forward the first 12 and report how many were skipped.

after.name: Limit a large feed to twelve items
after.description: Read up to sixty feed items, forward up to the first twelve to your webhook, and record how many were skipped.

before.name: Make sense of the news across your sources
before.description: Group related stories into a Ukrainian digest, check claims against linked articles, then approve the text before delivery.

after.name: Turn scattered news into one source-linked digest
after.description: Group related stories into a Ukrainian digest, check claims against linked articles, and approve the text before delivery.

before.name: Make sense of the news with your coding agent
before.description: Build the same source-linked Ukrainian digest through Claude or Codex, review its claims and approve delivery; no OpenRouter key.

after.name: Build a source-linked digest with your coding agent
after.description: Use Claude or Codex to create the same Ukrainian digest, check its claims and approve delivery, without an OpenRouter key.

before.name: Find the key ideas in a podcast transcript
before.description: Turn two transcript parts into a Ukrainian summary with checked timestamps, kept locally for your approval.

after.name: Find the key moments in a podcast transcript
after.description: Turn two transcript parts into a concise Ukrainian summary with checked timestamps. Review the exact text before approval.

before.name: Summarize a podcast with your coding agent
before.description: Use Claude or Codex to turn two transcript parts into a Ukrainian summary with checked timestamps; no OpenRouter key.

after.name: Summarize a transcript with your coding agent
after.description: Use Claude or Codex to produce the same Ukrainian transcript summary with checked timestamps, without an OpenRouter key.

before.name: SDD: agree on the result before changing code
before.description: Define the change, scope and acceptance criteria first. Approve the specification, then let your agent implement it and verify the allowed files.

after.name: Keep a code change within the scope you approve
after.description: Agree allowed files and acceptance criteria before edits. Approve the specification in your terminal, then let your agent implement the change, run your check and report the result.
